data.narrative:
Roboneers is a Growth-stage defense and security technology company founded by Anton and Oleksiy Skrypnyk. The company has raised $2M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Defense & Security peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems—though stage-matched peers within this sector remain limited.

Given data constraints, only one quantitative method proved applicable. The stage-progression approach uses Roboneers' $2M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for Growth-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $2.4M. Peer-median analysis could not be performed; while 23 Defense & Security companies exist in the broader dataset, none of the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters returned the minimum three datapoints required for meaningful median benchmarking.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $2.0M (low) to $2.76M (high), with a median of $2.4M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology and the scarcity of directly comparable Growth-stage peers in the Defense & Security sector. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or profitability data, limited stage-matched comps, and the absence of recent funding event data to validate whether $2M raised remains a reliable proxy for current enterprise value.
